jobs.employer_name: NaiStell Ivy Consulting AB
jobs.description:
Recruited by NaiStell Ivy Hire on behalf of our client
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Employment type: Part-time / Full-time
Language requirements: English or Swedish
Minimum experience: 2 years in fundraising

NaiStell Ivy Hire is a recruitment partner connecting talented professionals with organisations that make a difference. We are currently recruiting on behalf of a client specialising in face-to-face and door-to-door fundraising for humanitarian, environmental and social causes.
About the Role
We are looking for passionate, experienced and motivated fundraisers to join our client's growing team in Stockholm.
As a Door-to-Door Fundraiser, you will engage with people in their homes, introduce them to important humanitarian and environmental causes, and inspire them to become monthly donors. This role suits someone who loves talking to people and is passionate about making a difference through communication. You will represent the client's partner organisations with professionalism, enthusiasm and integrity.
Responsibilities
Conduct door-to-door fundraising campaigns in designated areas
Engage the public in meaningful conversations about humanitarian, environmental and social causes
Recruit new monthly donors through face-to-face communication
Communicate the mission, values and impact of the partner organisations
Build trust and positive relationships with potential donors
Maintain high standards of donor quality, professionalism and ethical fundraising
Work towards individual and team fundraising targets
Participate in training, team meetings and ongoing coaching

Who We Are Looking For
At least 2 years of experience in fundraising
Passion for speaking with people and building relationships
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Confident communication in English or Swedish
Self-motivated, positive, persistent and goal-oriented
Enjoy working outdoors and visiting different neighbourhoods
Comfortable initiating conversations with strangers
Genuine interest in humanitarian, environmental or social causes
Reliable, professional and committed to quality results
Able to work independently and as a strong team player

How to Apply
Apply through NaiStell Ivy Hire. We will review your application and, if it's a match, introduce you to our client. Forward your CV and cover letter to hire@naistellivy.com

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.employer_name: Engelska Skolor och Förskolor i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Would you like to spend two weeks teaching Science at a high-performing bilingual school?
Engelska Skolan Norr is looking for an engaged and responsible substitute Science teacher for Years 7-9 for a two-week period from the 11th of January to the 22nd of February, 2027.
This is a great opportunity to get to know our school, our students and our way of working. Whether you are currently looking for a teaching position, studying to become a teacher or simply interested in gaining experience in education, we would love to hear from you!
About our school
Engelska Skolan Norr is a high-performing bilingual school where strong academic results, motivated students and a collaborative staff culture create an environment where both teachers and learners thrive.
We follow the Swedish national curriculum (Lgr22) in a bilingual setting, with teaching in Science primarily conducted in English. We value high academic expectations, structured teaching and a strong focus on both subject knowledge and language development.
About the assignment
Teach Science (NO) in Years 7-9 in accordance with Lgr22.
Deliver structured and engaging lessons that maintain continuity in students' learning.
Support students with different learning needs and abilities.
Work collaboratively with colleagues and follow established plans and routines.
Contribute to a positive and focused learning environment.

We are looking for someone who:
Has a good knowledge of Science and an interest in teaching.
Is confident communicating in English and Swedish in a bilingual school environment.
Can create structure and engage students in their learning.
Is responsible, flexible and enjoys working with young people.
Values collaboration and a positive approach to education.

Teaching experience or relevant subject studies are an advantage.
Why join us?
This short-term assignment is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable classroom experience, develop your teaching skills and get to know our school and colleagues. It may also open doors to future opportunities at Engelska Skolan Norr.
Interested? Get in touch with us and tell us a little about yourself and your availability.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för elever i 30 år. Hos oss får du möjligheten att besöka världen fast på hemmaplan. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska. Vi strävar efter att vara en skola där lärare kan fokusera på att undervisa, elever ges möjlighet att lära sig och där alla tycker om att komma till skolan.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker nu flexibla och engagerade lärare mot fritidshem  (grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot fritidshem)  till vårt team på IES Staffanstorp! 

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kan inkludera att:

- Stötta en eller flera elever i deras lärande och sociala utveckling, både i och utanför klassrummet.
- Samverka med klasslärare i årskurserna F-3.
- Planering av aktiviteter och lektioner inom vår fritidshem (Lgr22)
- Bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö under lektioner och raster.
- Vara behjälplig vid övriga arbetsuppgifter som förekommer i skolverksamheten.
- Mentorsansvar

Vi söker dig som:

- Brinner för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar.
- Är flexibel, anpassningsbar och har lätt för att samarbeta.
- Utbildad lärare  (grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot fritidshem) 
- Har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vårt team på IES Staffanstorp! 

Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vår inspirerande och lärorika skolmiljö.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.employer_name: VALJOCHSLAPP
jobs.description:
Om jobbet:
Vi söker nu pålitliga och serviceinriktade leveransförare till vårt team i norra Stockholm. Hos Valjochslapp arbetar vi med att leverera paket och varor snabbt, säkert och med ett trevligt bemötande direkt till våra kunder.
Tjänsten är på heltid med varierande arbetstider förlagda till både morgon- och kvällspass (cirka kl. 06:00–14:00 och 16:00–23:00 enligt schema). Du utgår från vår depå i norra Stockholm och kör ett av företagets fordon.
Dina arbetsuppgifter:
Lasta och säkra leveranser i fordonet inför din rutt.
Planera och köra effektiva leveransrutter under morgon- och kvällstid.
Leverera varor till privatpersoner och företag med fokus på god kundservice.
Hantera digital leveransrapportering via handdator eller mobilapp.
Hålla fordonet rent, snyggt och trafiksäkert.

Kvalifikationer och krav:
Körkort: Giltigt B-körkort för manuell växellåda som du har haft i minst 6 månader (svenskt eller EU/EES).
Språk: Goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska i tal och skrift för att kunna kommunicera med kunder och kollegor.
Arbetstider: Du är flexibel och har möjlighet att arbeta både tidiga morgnar, sena kvällar samt helger enligt schema.
Personliga egenskaper: Du är punktlig, ansvarstagande, stresstålig och trivs med att arbeta självständigt i ett högt tempo.
Tidigare erfarenhet av budkörning eller serviceyrken är meriterande, men inget krav.

Anställningsvillkor:
Omfattning: Heltid (100 %), skiftarbete (morgon, kväll och helg).
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning (3 månader) med god möjlighet till förlängning.
Tillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan:
Skicka din ansökan med CV och ett kort personligt brev till jobb@valjochslapp.se märkt med "Leveransförare". Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!

English Summary:
Valjochslapp is looking for reliable, service-minded full-time Delivery Drivers based in Northern Stockholm.
Hours: Full-time (100%), rotating shifts covering early mornings (approx. 06:00–14:00), evenings (approx. 16:00–23:00), and weekends according to schedule.
Requirements: Valid manual B-driver's license held for at least 6 months (Swedish or EU/EEA), good communication skills in Swedish or English, and flexibility to work morning, evening, and weekend shifts. Previous delivery experience is a merit, not a requirement.
Employment: Fixed-term contract (3 months) with strong potential for extension. Start date immediately or by agreement.
How to apply: Send your CV and a brief introduction to jobb@valjochslapp.se with the subject "Leveransförare". Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Vi söker nu en skoladministratör.

Som skoladministratör är du en mycket viktig resurs för skolledningen, personal och elever. Du kommer att stötta i många olika typer av administrativa uppgifter och som ansiktet utåt i receptionen är det viktigt med god kommunikation och att skapa positiva relationer. 

Huvuduppgifter:

Hantera skolans kösystem, vara kontaktperson för Uppsala kommun både vad gäller elever och modersmål, ta emot besök, stötta skolans vikariekoordinator, följa upp elevfrånvaro dagligen, uppdatera skolans hemsida,, beställa diverse material/tjänster, bokningar för skolutflykter, ansvar för receptionens telefon, post och email.

Kvalifikationer:

- Goda kunskaper i svenska då du måste vara väl insatt i kommunens system IST
- Goda kunskaper i engelska då kommunikationen internt sker på engelska
- Utbildning inom administration.
- Tidigare erfarenhet inom administrativt arbete, gärna inom skolvärlden, är meriterande.
- Goda kunskaper i Google paketet (Docs, sheets, forms, slides).
- God datorvana överlag

Vem är du?

Du är flexibel, strukturerad och arbetar systematiskt. 

Du har en positiv attityd, är "service minded" och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer.

Du tar ansvar och ser möjligheter istället för problem.

Du är stresstålig och morgonpigg.

Du kan kommunicera tydligt i både skrift och tal, på både engelska och svenska.

Du har erfarenhet som administratör eller liknande uppgifter 

Startdatum är början av januari 2027 men rekryteringen och intervjuerna sker fortlöpande, så sök direkt om du är intresserad! Har du frågor om tjänsten hör av dig till susanna.frank.uppsala@engelska.se

jobs.description:
Vi söker en kvalificerad lärare i SvA på 50% för ett vikariat mellan v. 45-51 med chans till förlängning under VT.  

Att vara en del av IES innebär att du varje dag kommer att befinna dig i en verkligt internationell miljö. Vi har både lärare och elever från alla hörn av världen. Här möts du dagligen av engagerade och motiverade medarbetare som arbetar tillsammans för att säkerställa att vi fortsätter att leverera höga akademiska resultat. På IES är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att trivas hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och arbetssätt.

 Arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

- Undervisa nyanlända i SvA.

- Undervisa i språkval svenska samt stötte elever vid behov.

- Skapa en stimulerande klassrumsmiljö för effektiv undervisning och inlärning.

- Upprätthålla skolans positiva etos och kärnvärden, både i och utanför klassrummet.

- Rapportera till föräldrar om elevernas utveckling, framsteg och prestationer.

Vem är du?

- Du har en svensk lärarlegitimation.

- Har erfarenhet av att undervisa i detta ämne.

- Har goda kunskaper i engelska.

- Har en passion för att undervisa och motivera elever att nå sina mål.

- Har förmågan att skapa en inkluderande lärandemiljö för eleverna.

- Du är entusiastisk, engagerad och en lagspelare.

- Du har kunskap om och delar värderingarna och etos på Internationella Engelska Skolan.

Intervjuer kommer att genomföras löpande, så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen.

jobs.description:
Är du en person som tror på kraften i rörelse och vill göra skillnad för barn både i och utanför klassrummet? Vi söker nu en grundlärare med inriktning mot arbete i fritidshem, ingång, idrott och hälsa inför HT26.

 IES Österåker är en dynamisk och växande skola där vi kombinerar akademisk excellens med en varm, familjär atmosfär. Vi befinner oss i en spännande expansionsfas och inför höstterminen 2026 når vi vår fulla kapacitet som en tvåparallellig F–9-skola. Trots att vi växer i storlek, håller vi hårt i den trygghet och gemenskap som definierar oss, här är varje elev sedd och varje kollega en viktig del av teamet.

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med inriktning mot fritidshem och behörighet att undervisa i idrott och hälsa (åk 1–3), alternativt har en likvärdig pedagogisk bakgrund. I den här tjänsten får du det bästa av två världar, pedagogisk undervisning i idrott och hälsa för åk 1-3, samt en spännande roll i vår fritidshemsverksamhet. 

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med inriktning mot fritidshem, ingång, idrott och hälsa eller annan likvärdig behörighet att undervisa idrott i åk 1-3. Det är meriterande att du är tvåspråkig (svenska och engelska) och känner dig bekväm med att kommunicera på båda språken i en internationell miljö. Du ska även ha förmågan att skapa trygghet och bygga starka relationer med elever, föräldrar och kollegor. Du ska vara en positiv förebild som brinner för hälsa och en aktiv livsstil.

jobs.employer_name: Perido AB
jobs.description:
Are you an organized and service-minded professional who thrives in an administrative role? Do you have the ability to multitask and work proactively in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to efficiency and structure in a workplace where your efforts truly make a difference? Then you might be the right person for this position! Apply today with your application in English and in the Europass CV template.
About the position
We are looking for an Administrative Assistant for our client, an independent and important agency of the European Union. This position is based at their office, just north of central Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
Provide daily administrative management of the project, including drafting notes, minutes, correspondence, and necessary follow-up
Organise and coordinate appointments, business trips, and meetings, including the logistical preparations, documentation, and follow-up
Assist in the preparation and follow-up of financial documents, such as orders and reimbursements
Manage electronic and paper documents (contact lists, mailing, scanning, filing, and archiving
Work closely with the project manager/members and centralised support functions to identify and resolve issues related to the project
Communicate, cooperate, and liaise with a range of internal stakeholders
Travel, alongside other staff, for the purposes of supporting logistics during missions and meetings abroad

Your characteristics
We are looking for an administrative assistant with excellent teamwork skills and strong interpersonal abilities, capable of communicating effectively with people at all levels within the organization. The role requires a highly service-oriented mindset, combined with tact and discretion. The ideal candidate has a strong sense of responsibility, can work independently, deliver results, and pays close attention to detail. In addition, they possess excellent organizational skills, can prioritize tasks efficiently, and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Note! For this position you need to provide us with a curriculum vitae in English and in the Europass CV template (https://europa.eu/europass/sv). We also need a letter of motivation, explaining which job specific expertise and personal characteristics you can bring to the job (of maximum 1 page).
Qualifications:
Proven experience as an administrative assistant/secretary, preferably in a multicultural working environment
Experience in working with support tasks in the areas of project management, procurement, contract management, budgets, and/or statistics
Excellent skills in preparing correspondence and other documentation
Good numerical skills
Thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook) and experience in maintaining databases
Proven experience in contributing to the organisation of meetings
Excellent command of English, spoken and written

Meritorious:
Experience working internationally is an additional benefit

Contract type and hours
Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-03-31. Start in January.
Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36041 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.employer_name: Luleå Tekniska Universitet
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics.
 
 
Subject description
 
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
 
 
Project description
 
RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects.
 
 
Duties
 
As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas:
 
 
Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments
 
a. Agentic planning and reasoning
 
- Semantic mission planning using foundation models
 
- Task decomposition based on foundation models
 
- Event-driven task replanning
 
 
b. Autonomous inspection planning
 
- Uncertainty aware planning
 
- Multi-agent systems for inspection planning
 
 
Qualifications
 
To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required.
 
 
For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en.
 
 
Further information
 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to four years. Teaching and other departmental duties may be added, up to 20% of full-time working hours. The place of work is Luleå, and the starting date is by agreement.
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.
 
 
For further information, please contact:
 
George Nikolakopoulos, Chaired Professor, +46 920-49 1298 mailto:geonik@ltu.se
 
 
https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontactsrepresentatives
 
 
In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions o this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.
 
 
Application
 
We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.
 
 
Closing date for applications: 7 December 2026
 
Reference number: 5833-2026

jobs.description:
Spanish Teacher / Spansklärare 30%

Internationella Engelska Skolan Falun is a school for grades 4-9 with 450 students. The school started in 2014 and has since grown and established itself. The school is located near Falun center, close to buses and parks.

The school has an international focus and teaching is conducted in both English and Swedish depending on the subject. The school works to put learning and knowledge first. We are a school with a clear set of values, with a safe work environment, good discipline and a lot of care. Students must learn to take personal responsibility for their development and work environment and to respect their schoolmates, teachers and themselves.

We are looking for a qualified Spanish teacher to join our team in January 2027.

What we offer

✔ A real international workplace with colleagues from all over the world

✔ All IES schools in Sweden are based on the same foundations for the vision of the school, namely the IES Ethos. Feel free to read more about this and see if they align with your own professional values ​​and beliefs.

✔ At IES all employees receive a pedagogical lunch. 

Your mission

✔ You need to have the qualifications and competence to teach years 6-9 in Spanish.

✔ The position is a permanent employment of 30% and includes teaching for groups of students in years 6-9. 

At our school you get to work together with driven and committed colleagues who, together with the students, find new ways to learn and understand their world. By combining language, creativity and high academic quality, we help our students reach their full potential.

Your profile

✔ We believe that you are creative, responsible and innovative. 

✔ You are committed to your work and have the ability to engage others. Experience of similar roles is an advantage. 

✔ You are motivated by having regular contact with guardians and collaborating with colleagues in a supportive environment.

✔ You value and deliver a personal, clear and balanced leadership with both control and student engagement in focus. As a teacher, you are a clear and an active standard setter.

✔ Adequate university education and teaching credentials are a prerequisite. You have a professional appearance when dealing with students, guardians and colleagues.

✔ There are no requirements for previous teaching experience, but we would like you to be confident in your professional leadership where you can create a safe and stable environment both inside and outside the classroom.

✔ Swedish teacher qualifications and previous experience are an advantage.

For permanent positions Swedish qualifications (lärarlegitimation) is required.

Do not hesitate to send in your application or contact us for further conversation. Based on who you are and what your qualifications look like, we can plan the organization in slightly different ways.

Please submit your CV and cover letter through IES Careers. Interviews are ongoing and the deadline for applications is 22 November 2026.

Questions can be referred to Principal Carolina Browall at principal.falun@engelska.se
